description: Provisional 1.32 legal-frame reaction matrix covering amplifying, transformative, Frozen/Shatter, Swirl, Crystallize, Catalyze, Burning, Dendro-core reactions, and player reaction self-damage.

notes: This is a deterministic regression fixture for the checked-in implementation, not official game data or a claim of complete gcsim parity.
Player Burning, Bloom, Burgeon, and Hyperbloom self-damage is modeled against an explicit 10% resistance vector with auditable spatial checks, HP transitions, damage groups, and reverse references.
Burning preserves the frozen 1.30 compatibility phase difference (F+121 and hit-before-tick ordering).
Enemy hitlag clocks, player movement, healing, death/revival, non-Crystallize shields, and ordinary enemy attacks are not modeled.
Complete Aura source overlap, character ICD databases, particles, action frames, reaction hooks, and character/weapon databases remain outside this fixture.
